title: Enchanting Vanilla Lite
description: A modpack better than vanilla,but not just better
body:
# 简体中文
## 这个整合包推荐Java 25，需要Java 22及以上！！！
这个整合包比原版好，但不止步于比原版好。  
这个整合包有着比原版更好的性能，并且有LOD机制。  
这个整合包包含**机械动力飞跃版**(Create Fly)(一个机械动力版本，给在1.21.8版本之后的Fabric使用)，并且机械动力飞跃版优化也十分好。  
此整合包没有魔改，可以放心按原版发展路线来。  
# English
## This modpack recommends Java 25, and requires Java 22 or higher!
A modpack better than vanilla,but not just better.  
This modpack offers better performance than vanilla Minecraft and includes an LOD (Level of Detail) mechanism.  
This modpack includes **Create Fly** (version of Create for Minecraft then 1.21.8 with Fabric Loader), which is also highly optimized.  
This modpack contains no gameplay-altering modifications, so you can safely follow the vanilla progression path.
